reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and threads it through every existing caller, but does not factor out the weekend-or-holiday predicate it needs elsewhere.

duplication.why: The 'weekend or in holidays' check is written inline four times (getDateWithSkippedWeekend, both daily-skip loops in getNextDate, getDatesInRange) instead of one isExcludedDay helper.

placement.why: Date adjustment logic stays in shared/schedules.ts and the type change lands in RecurConfig, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Focused on holidays, with one unrelated reformat of an existing test in schedules/app.test.ts.

maintainability.why: The moving logic is cleanly generalised, but the repeated inline predicate (with a different skipWeekend guard in getDatesInRange) means the next change to excluded days must be made in several places.

one_place.where: Moving is centralised in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily-skip rule re-checks holidays inline in getNextDate (two loops) and schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange.
